item.title: Drop in opioid overdose deaths nears 50% since 2023
item.description: Since their peak less than three years ago, opioid overdose deaths dropped nearly by half as of October, according to a Stateline analysis. The drop comes as a shrinking fentanyl supply has made the drug weaker and less deadly and volunteer efforts get more people into treatment. The weaker fentanyl tracks to a crackdown on […]

item.title: Contraception services dropped after ‘defunding’ provision hit clinics
item.description: Visits for contraception and cancer screenings at Planned Parenthood clinics have dropped by double-digits after Congress passed a bill cutting off Medicaid funding to certain reproductive health care providers last year, according to a new Democratic congressional report. item.title: US Senate confirms Mullin as next Homeland Security boss
